title: Duniya mein haider dusra
body:
Duniya mein haider dusra
Dhoond ne nikle the jo duniya mein Haider doosra
<<DIVIDER>>
Mill nahi paaya unhe ab tak Qalandar doosra
1. Hai kahaan Jibreel jo Rizwaan laaya hai libaas
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya Ali ne rakh liya hai ghar mein naukar doosra
2. Hum tumhe dikhlaaenge Yusuf Ali ki aal mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum na dikhla paaoge Nabiyo'n mein Akbar doosra
3. Jab Nabi kehte the Khaiber mein lade jaa kar koi
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekhta tha ek ko fauran palatkar doosra
4. Iss ko maara hai Ali ne ye Ali ka kaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Deklo hai pehle hisse ke baraabar doosra
5. Tegho'n ke saaye mein sona bus Ali ka kaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhaag hi jaata agar hota waha'n par doosra
6. Aam darwaaze se jaae'n kyu khawaas-e-Kibriya
<<DIVIDER>>
Hoga Kaabe mein Ali ke vaaste dar doosra
7. Le to aaye hai saqeefa waale rehbar doosra
<<DIVIDER>>
Laayenge lekin kahaa'n se khum ka mimbar doosra
8. Keh rahi hai ye adaae'n Asghar-e-besheer ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Chahiye in mutthiyo'n ko baab-e-Khaiber doosra
author: Mir Hassan Mir
